Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes Abort Responses tool arguments after 32,768 consecutive trailing whitespace characters, retry through existing recovery, and identify watchdog aborts in diagnostics. **Example:** An exec argument streams 32 consecutive deltas containing 1,024 whitespace characters each. - **Before:** The deltas keep the idle timer alive until the session watchdog interrupts the stalled request. - **After:** The accumulator rejects the unfinished call with degenerate_output, closes the request, and permits bounded transient recovery. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The focused patch and exact-head gates support correctness; independently inspectable behavior evidence remains limited to the committed test composition. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | This maintainer-authored PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; its body reports successful recovery in a real isolated Gateway soak, while the inspectable committed regressions use mocked OpenAI transport and real stream/recovery owners. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** An embedded agent can spend minutes generating whitespace inside an unfinished tool call before watchdog recovery begins. **Reason:** The reported production incidents justify a small bounded guard, and maintainer authorship supplies direction for the threshold without another product decision. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep open: this maintainer-authored PR addresses a concrete agent stall using the existing stream and retry owners; no actionable correctness or security findings remain. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The reported live Gateway soak has no attached request/abort/retry trace for independent inspection.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The shared Responses processor converts provider events into assistant text and completed tool calls; transport errors feed the embedded runner's existing recovery policy. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Responses HTTP or WebSocket] --> B[Shared stream processor] B --> C[Argument whitespace counter] C --> D[Completed tool calls] C --> E[Typed stream error] E --> F[Transport cancellation and diagnostics] F --> G[Existing bounded retry owner] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Use the shared accumulator's bounded whitespace guard and existing recovery policy while preserving terminal tool validation and content-free diagnostics. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current-main source refreshes request activity for argument deltas without limiting whitespace churn, matching the reported stall; no target code was executed during this read-only review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The patch is a small complete repair: one per-call counter rejects the reported runaway at the shared producer, while existing transport cancellation, terminal validation, and bounded recovery retain their responsibilities. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [8b1ac41c3145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b1ac41c3145ae2ab1018d6c2f4ec5c43b576fc5). ### Provenance checked - `Shared argument accumulation and terminal parsing` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/128166: Keep large argument assembly responsive with geometric preview parsing while preserving authoritative terminal arguments; the new counter leaves that behavior intact.) - `Diagnostic watchdog recovery` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/141869: Interrupt eligible active model requests through the existing attempt owner so recovery can proceed without expiring the parent reply; this patch only adds structured origin attribution.) - `Transport error diagnostics` keeps the original intent (https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176915: Identify cancellation using fixed labels without logging provider messages or prompt/tool content; the added degenerate_output label follows that contract.) ### Testing Proof path: in-process harness. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Pinned introduced change:** The merge-base-to-head diff adds one counter per active call, a typed error, transport cancellation, retry classification, watchdog attribution, documentation, and focused regressions. ([`packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-stream-errors.ts:17`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a/packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-stream-errors.ts#L17), [c9c13c9d2024](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a)) - **Request cancellation preserves retry classification:** The transport aborts its request-scoped controller with the typed error while projecting failure against the caller signal, preserving error rather than user-cancellation semantics. ([`packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-client.ts:620`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a/packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-client.ts#L620), [c9c13c9d2024](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a)) - **Distinct regression contracts:** Added tests inspect rejection before toolcall_end, iterator closure, request abortion, content-free diagnostics, recovery classification, a legitimate 200 KiB argument, and watchdog attribution; these tests were inspected, not executed during this review. ([`packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-client.terminal-error.test.ts:118`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a/packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-client.terminal-error.test.ts#L118), [c9c13c9d2024](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a)) - **Existing logging contract respected:** The merged direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/176915 requires fixed abort labels without provider prose; this PR adds one fixed label and supplies the missing watchdog code at its producer. ([`packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-debug.ts:389`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/aba4ede1e9fff6ea552d72aaba7cc0bc68e5b682/packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-debug.ts#L389), [aba4ede1e9ff](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/aba4ede1e9fff6ea552d72aaba7cc0bc68e5b682)) - **Current main still needs the change:** Comparison with fetched main shows an independent terminal-event refactor, without this whitespace guard or watchdog-producer attribution; the introduced hunks remain distinct. ([`packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-stream-internal.ts`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/8b1ac41c3145ae2ab1018d6c2f4ec5c43b576fc5/packages/ai/src/transports/openai-responses-stream-internal.ts), [8b1ac41c3145](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/8b1ac41c3145ae2ab1018d6c2f4ec5c43b576fc5)) - **Exact-head gates passed:** The current head remains c9c13c9d20249cd6dcc6e4577fb41fc59b45f32a; GitHub reports a clean merge and successful CI, dependency-review, and security-sensitive-review statuses.
